title: Zesty Glazed French Fish Tartine
description: A pungent and sweet French dish featuring fish, sugar syrup, and a glassy jelly glaze, perfect for a lazy Sunday, served in a hot pot vessel. This Provence-inspired recipe is pescatarian-friendly and easy to make.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fish fillets with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cod fish fillets and cook for 3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the hot pot vessel to the preheated oven and bake for 8 minutes.
While the fish is baking, mix the sugar syrup and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Remove the hot pot vessel from the oven and brush the sugar syrup mixture over the fish.
Top the fish with the jelly glaze and serve immediately.
